name: Tielman Brothers
description:
The '''Tielman Brothers''' were a Dutch-Indonesian [[rock band]], whose 1958 single "Rock Little Baby of Mine" has been described as the first rock and roll single in Dutch history. Singer-guitarist [[Andy Tielman]] is the only constant member of the group through their entire career. 

They first played traditional folk music before transitioning to performing western music and [[rock and roll]]. The band became famous in Europe for playing [[Indorock]], a fusion of Indonesian and Western music with roots in [[Kroncong]]. At the height of their career, in the 1950s and early 1960s, the band was hailed as one of the greatest live acts in Europe. 

They were active until disbanding in 1983, and reformed for a reunion in 1990.
